scope: Separate Ray Task_13 source-owned fission supplement; five cumulative stages with identical hardware, model and search budget.
source_binding: exact compiler source and optimizer bytes, canonical MLIR, architecture, model, cost and replay contracts; no SHA-256

search.algorithm: source-owned C++ MLIR complete-program neighborhood beam search
search.diversity_policy: distinct legal transformation paths or parameter configurations; fill shortfall with other unique candidates
search.shortlist_order: global archive cost order; diversity affects expansion only
search.candidate_state: complete program graph rewrite plus every task shape/replica decision
round_steps: source-owned canonical facts deduplicate while preserving paths
whole-program production scheduler score with explicit communication
search.previous_winner_decisions: mutable; replacement, withdrawal and alternative decisions permitted
search.cumulative_factor_proof: relative to source-authenticated original domains; tiling and replication independent, each product at most eight
search.fusion_action: one legal pair per primitive; larger groups by legal sequential actions
search.unsupported_unknown_policy: record separately; retain predecessor; not semantic-illegal and not an experiment-wide blocker
search.budget_policy: uniform across workload stages; record hits; any smaller initial version must use one separately bound uniform protocol
search.budget_expansion_policy: User authorized expansion when needed on 2026-10-03; apply uniformly through a new bound common protocol version, preserving prior budgeted best-found records.
search.profile_reason: uniform post-publication parameter expansion, candidate budget increased fourfold
search.model_domain_unsupported_policy: source-proved LB above model ceiling is unknown cost; graph retained; supported shapes still explored
search.canonical_identity_shape_note: canonical graph unchanged; start from minimum-area supported shape only if unit cost is proved outside ML interval; report all-unit unavailable separately

scoring.task_cost: Current source-owned C++ 148-feature queries and pinned four-member direct mapper-II mean; structural startup; fresh hardware/model cost namespace.
scoring.task_latency_contract: ceil(startup_cycles + predicted_ii * (trip_count - 1)); identical to existing C++ production score duration
scoring.replica_inheritance: only compiler-proven body equivalence, shard bounds and output coordinates
scoring.pruning: existing proved bounds and dynamic incumbent domain checks where applicable; heuristic priorities are not proof pruning
scoring.hardware_legality: actual-active capacity, placement non-overlap and route feasibility; temporal reuse allowed
scoring.communication_model_provenance: Separate existing ORBIT 4x4 directed mesh communication model, 1-cycle links / 32 bits per cycle. AMOEBA-Test paper architecture YAML has no inter_task_network section and remains byte-identical to the model architecture.

selection.prediction: C++ global archive top5 across all explored graphs/resources
selection.actual_stage_cycles: minimum whole-program native cycles across all legal measured stage candidates including controls
selection.regression_policy: investigate omissions, version changes and replay/protocol differences for S2-S5; no automatic claim added dimensions harmful
selection.mapper_failure_policy: preserve errors and continue other candidates; finite evidenced failure exits; no wall-clock timeout
selection.pending_policy: diagnostic table permitted; pending is not correctness/performance GO

checkpoint.resume: continue exact pending state, no restart from identity
checkpoint.storage: atomic writes, compressed immutable candidate snapshots where beneficial, avoid repeated large snapshots, disk guard

execution_policy.ML_cache: compiler-proven mapper-visible body and mapper shape with model and architecture contract
execution_policy.mapper_cache: identical mapper input and mapper shape with actual architecture contents
execution_policy.legacy_result_reuse: No legacy hardware/model cost, mapper, score or checkpoint reuse. Reuse only exact source body, target hardware bytes and new model bytes within this cohort.
execution_policy.delivery_priority: LLaMA then LU; extend remaining four workload curves under the same uniform expanded profile.

implementation_contract.placement_temporal_communication_scoring: C++ MLIR passes using the production spatial-temporal scheduler
implementation_contract.python_role: process orchestration, tests, and machine-record table rendering only

runtime_fix: Source affine coverage captured before control lowering; bounded carried internal loops expanded inside mapper firing; exact canonical partition coverage and body witness verified for actions/import/resume.

seed_revalidation.historical_modules: No old-domain candidate modules imported. Recreate lawful actions on freshly source-captured canonical inputs.

publication_variant: Minimal inputs and final observations; runtime task caches are regenerated.

source_iteration_domain.cost_units: one normalized mapper firing contains all certified internal work; startup + II * (current TF firing count - 1)
source_iteration_domain.partition_validation: full source-owned group proof, exact interval coverage, body/output/join/state; imported/stored candidates re-proved against immutable canonical

numeric_evidence_policy: tracked native gate; unique stage-local top5/control attempts; numeric failure or missing result distinct
model_portability: Self-contained export of four pinned direct-ensemble members; exact source architecture, 148 raw/61 selected features, mean readout. New namespace and fresh task costs; no old 4x4 labels reused.
sram_capacity_status: pending: AMOEBA-Test YAML and script do not establish per-CGRA SRAM byte capacity
